title: 第1744章 防不胜防一波未平一波又起第1743章 谁给他们时间炸了
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
过了一会儿，焱黎才彻底收敛，认真地看向夜云。
“主上，先前冥鬼教高层都在，幽冥毒粉已经散播开，在场的几乎都或多或少的吸入了毒粉。
有那张纸条分散他们的注意力，他们不会立刻察觉。
等到他们反应过来，一切都晚了。
幽冥毒粉已经深入他们的肺腑，想要解毒，没那么容易。”
焱黎之所以要设计纸条这么一出，目的可不单单只是羞辱冥鬼教主。
真正目的，其实是为了转移他们的注意力。
幽冥毒粉被吸入后不会立刻生效，冥鬼教高层不会立即察觉。
注意力被分散，想要察觉这一点，难度就更大了。
不得不说，焱黎的确是心思缜密。
提前就已经考虑好，该如何让他们悄无声息地中毒。
等他们真正反应过来的时候，一切都已经晚了。
“妙啊！阿黎，这一招用得妙。
声东击西，让他们防不胜防。
当他们发现中毒的时候，已经为时已晚，咱们只需要等待冥鬼教彻底崩盘即可。”
整个过程看上去似乎很简单，冥鬼教一个如此庞大的魔族势力，按道理来说不可能会被这么简单的手段给弄得土崩瓦解。
可实际上要想完成这样的操作，却一点也不容易。
炼制魔傀一事，是一件相当有难度的事情。
只是焱黎刚好懂得天渊魔宗的炼傀之法，真正掌握这门炼傀之法的人，在天渊魔宗也没几个。
而焱黎更是其中数一数二的。

想要满足这一点，就已经非常困难了。
而空溟水蚀这种剧毒，即便是在仙域夜家，数量也非常稀少。
也就是夜云，之前弄到了一些。
此番，夜云手中空溟水蚀已经用得差不多了。
苏卿雪眺望着远处的绝冥山脉，总感觉一切都那么的不真实。
仅凭她自己，复仇是一件相当有难度的事情。
可到了夜云这里，复仇之事竟然变得如此轻松。
当然，复仇的手段虽然并不光彩，但在苏卿雪看来，这根本无所谓，她也不在乎。
阴煞魔宗和冥鬼教协同那些小魔宗进攻雪门时，同样也用了一些卑劣的手段。
现在，不过是以彼之道还施彼身罢了。
既然魔族可以行卑劣之事，其他人自然也可以。
…………
三日后。
由于三天前魔傀自爆，导致线索全断。
冥鬼教主便直接下令，让还能行动的教中弟子沿绝冥山脉向外搜索。
凡是有任何可疑之人，通通拿下。
这本就是冥鬼教的地盘，把那些可疑的家伙拿下，自然是没什么问题，冥鬼教也不怕有谁来找麻烦。
只是这么做，无异于是大海捞针。
魔傀被制作完成后，本身是可以自由行动的，即便是有幕后之人掌控，对方也可以隔得老远操控。
本来冥鬼教主之前还怀疑，是人族暗中对付冥鬼教。

可现在，他却认为和人族无关。
支撑这个猜想的首要原因就是魔傀。
content_en:
After a while, Yan Li completely restrained himself and looked at Ye Yun seriously.
"My lord, the Netherworld poisonous powder has been spread since all the high-level officials of the Netherworld Sect were here, and almost everyone present has inhaled the poisonous powder to some extent.
With the note distracting them, they wouldn't notice right away.
By the time they reacted, it was too late.
The Nether Poison Powder has penetrated deeply into their hearts, and it is not that easy to detoxify them. "
The reason why Yan Li designed the note was not just to humiliate the Underworld Cult Leader.
The real purpose is to divert their attention.
The Nether Poison Powder will not take effect immediately after being inhaled, and the Netherworld Sect's senior leaders will not notice it immediately.
When attention is divided, it becomes more difficult to detect this.
I have to say that Yan Li is indeed thoughtful.
He had already thought about how to poison them silently.
By the time they really reacted, it was already too late.
"Wonderful! Ali, this is a wonderful move.
Making attacks in the east and west, making them hard to defend against.
By the time they discovered they were poisoned, it was already too late. We just had to wait for the Ghost Sect to collapse completely. "
The whole process seems very simple. Logically speaking, such a huge demonic force cannot be destroyed by such a simple method.
But in fact, it is not easy at all to complete such an operation.
Refining a demon puppet is a very difficult matter.
It's just that Yan Li happens to know the puppet refining method of Tianyuan Demon Sect. There are only a few people in Tianyuan Demon Sect who truly master this puppet refining method.
And Yan Li is one of the best.
It is already very difficult to satisfy this point.
As for the extremely poisonous water erosion of Kongming, even in the Fairyland Ye Family, the number is very rare.
That is Ye Yun, who got some before.
This time, Ye Yun had almost used up the water erosion in his hand.
Su Qingxue looked at the Jueming Mountains in the distance, always feeling that everything was so unreal.
On her own, revenge is a very difficult thing.
But when Ye Yun came here, revenge became so easy.
Of course, although the method of revenge was not glorious, in Su Qingxue's view, it didn't matter at all, and she didn't care.
When the Yinsha Demon Sect and the Underworld Sect collaborated with the small demon sects to attack Xuemen, they also used some despicable methods.
Now, it is just a matter of repaying the other person with his own way.
Since demons can do despicable things, so can other people.
…………
Three days later.
Because the demon puppet self-destructed three days ago, all clues were lost.
The leader of the Ninggui Cult directly ordered the disciples of the sect who could still move to search outwards along the Jueming Mountains.
Anyone who seems suspicious will be captured.
This is the territory of the Underworld Cult. If we take down those suspicious guys, there will be no problem. The Underworld Cult is not afraid of anyone coming to cause trouble.
Just doing this is like looking for a needle in a haystack.
After the demon puppet is made, it can move freely. Even if it is controlled by someone behind the scenes, the other party can control it from a distance.
Originally, the leader of the Underworld Cult had suspected that the human race was secretly dealing with the Underworld Cult.
But now, he thinks it has nothing to do with the human race.
The primary reason supporting this conjecture is the demon puppet.
